propositions: An optional isolated adapter must mine Claude Code session transcripts via error-signature grep to reconstruct local environment and integration diagnostics, with deterministic (non-LLM) keyword/regex classification and explicit low-confidence labeling.
The adapter must classify matched error signatures into exactly five enum values (env_setup, dependency, integration, tooling, none) using first-match routing rules over candidate transcript lines.
Emitted records must carry source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified to segregate these values from authoritative structural series.
The core metrics package (registry.py, __init__.py) must not import the transcript adapter to ensure portability; the adapter is quarantined behind the backfill script only.
Unit tests must cover adapter classification against fixture JSONL transcripts, backfill script invocation, and enum/schema definitions — all without LLM or network calls.
